testScenarios.objective: Verify that the Graphics driver is updated correctly by using “have disk” method.
testScenarios.notes: Do not update driver over the same version. Make note of the previous graphics driver version installed on the DUT from the device manager.
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
1. Setup the DUT with the Base OS image, software and firmware required.
2. Go to Device Manager → Display Adapters → right click on the display adapter to be tested.
3. Click on properties → Go to “Driver” tab and select “Update driver”.
4. Click on “Browse my computer for driver software”.
5. Click on “Let me pick from a list of available drivers on my computer” and then click on “Have disk”.
6. Browse to the location of the graphics driver to be tested and chose the *.inf file. The driver should start to be installed.
7. After the driver is installed, check if the correct version of graphics driver and audio driver are installed, reboot the system.
8. Right click on desktop and see if there is any shortcut added in the menu (for Intel or Nvidia GFX drivers). There shouldn’t be any shortcut or add-on added.
9. Click on “Start” and verify there are not any programs added for the GFX adapter(s) installed.
10. Verify there are not icons added in the bottom right side of the taskbar.
11. Check task manager is not showing new processes or services related with Nvidia/Intel GFX after installation.
testScenarios.passFailCriteria:
The test will pass if the following conditions are not seen:
a) The expected behavior mentioned in the procedure is not seen
b) There are visual anomalies, BSOD, hangs while installing the GFX driver.
